generation.method: Genuine crest-only painted crop, hand-declared surface masks; preserve every original native body/alpha pixel outside the crest rectangles. Original source remains historical painted 2D input.
generation.prompt: CREST-ONLY PAINTED EDIT. FIRST IMAGE is the exact EXISTING genuine painted 2D Shurima villageHall town building, shown at technical 4x native scale for locality. SECOND IMAGE is the official Shurima regional crest SHAPE reference only (not pixels to paste). THIRD IMAGE is actual original Heroes of Might and Magic III Castle town background for rendering-language reference only, not architectural content to copy. Preserve FIRST image exact dimensions, alpha, every pixel/body silhouette, sandstone blocks, linen, wood, bronze, stairs, window, roof, trim, perspective and upper-left light outside the crest surfaces. Do not make the entire image smoother or add detail to the body. ONLY replace the existing generic medallion in the middle of the FRONT WOODEN DOOR with a clear weathered pale-bronze Shurima regional SUN-DISC-AND-HORIZONTAL-WINGS crest matching second image: circular solar disc above a long wide horizontal wing bar, narrow descending central pointed sun-ray stem and short downward rays. Use a comfortably legible ~18-20 native pixel wide, ~18 native pixel tall door-mounted carved/painted crest, which is ~72-80 pixels wide/tall in this technical4x input. It belongs embossed into the existing door medallion area, no new huge object, no floating badge. Also replace the generic small symbols on BOTH existing front IVORY LINEN banners flanking the door with the SAME Shurima crest in warm dark bronze pigment, naturally following folds. Banner marks should fit the existing cloth and be bold but not spill outside it. Leave the cloth itself, borders, cloth shapes and all architecture unchanged. No letters, text, extra banners, recolor or redesign. Original HoMM3 1999 weathered painted material treatment; no 3D inputs/production, vector decals, mobilegamegloss, anime or splash art. Return one RGBA edited image, exact same source size/composition/transparency.
